items.question: Compared with LINE, what exact MicroF1 improvement does DeepWalk achieve on the sparsest multilabel classification benchmark reported in the experiments?
items.why_unanswerable: The passage mentions 5%-10% MicroF1 gains on the sparsest problems, but it does not name LINE or provide a DeepWalk-vs-LINE comparison.

items.question: What exact parallel hardware configuration did DeepWalk use to build web-scale graph representations for YouTube, such as the number of machines or CPU cores?
